safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting localized rash/redness at the sting site when the reference finding indicates no rash could bias clinicians toward diagnosing a larger local allergic reaction or early infection, potentially prompting unnecessary medications (e.g., antihistamines/antibiotics) or altered follow-up. While unlikely to directly cause severe harm, it can lead to inappropriate management and reduced diagnostic accuracy.
